title: The River Is Flowing
about: Widely credited to Diana Hildebrand-Hull; sung as a commons across circle-song traditions. It is printed in Rainbow AU songs, vol. A, song #244, p.50 (hand-notated). The melody here follows the singing on “The River is Flowing … A video presentation” — SONGS I LOVE, YouTube. It is also heard on Ananda Das compilation (1:16:11) · Mettaben collection, “the_river_she_is_flowing” (CC BY-NC-SA).
